cues.zh: 《商业周刊》本周发布了年度航空旅客报告
cues.en: Business Week Magazine released its annual air travelers report this week

cues.zh: 布拉格的弗兰兹·卡夫卡国际机场排名垫底
cues.en: with Prague's Franz Kafka International Airport ranking last

cues.zh: 原因是航班延误严重、服务糟糕
cues.en: in customer satisfaction due to long flight delays, poor service,

cues.zh: 整体氛围压抑又冷漠
cues.en: and an overall oppressive, impersonal atmosphere.

cues.zh: 报告发现，弗兰兹·卡夫卡国际机场的平均延误时间
cues.en: The report found the average delay at Franz Kafka International

cues.zh: 比排名倒数第二的机场长31小时
cues.en: is 31 hours longer than the next worst airport.

cues.zh: 我们采访了几位美国旅客，他们说自己等航班
cues.en: We spoke to several American travelers who reported spending

cues.zh: 一等就是好几周，有些人甚至等了几个月
cues.en: weeks and in some cases, months, waiting for flights.

cues.zh: 我问售票员我的航班在哪个登机口，对方说
cues.en: I asked the ticket person what gate my flight was at and they said that

cues.zh: 我乘坐的那家航空公司根本不存在
cues.en: the airline I was flying didn't exist.

cues.zh: 而且大家一直叫我“S”
cues.en: And everyone keeps calling me "S".

cues.zh: 报告还指出，这座机场很难找路
cues.en: The airport was also cited as difficult to navigate,

cues.zh: 投诉中包括机场周边的接驳车服务
cues.en: with a list of complaints including curbside shuttle services

cues.zh: 它们绕机场兜一圈，最后又把乘客送回
cues.en: which loop around the airport before depositing passengers back

cues.zh: 出发地点；还有极长的走廊，尽头却是死路。
cues.en: at their starting point, and extremely long corridors leading to dead ends.

cues.zh: B2登机口在B11登机口旁边。B14登机口在F航站楼。
cues.en: Gate B2 is next to gate B11. And gate B14 is in the F terminal.

cues.zh: 《商业周刊》还把弗朗茨·卡夫卡国际机场评为最差机场之一
cues.en: Business Week also rated Franz Kafka International among the worst airports

cues.zh: 在客户服务方面，称员工
cues.en: in terms of customer service, calling the employees

cues.zh: “对旅客的需求完全无动于衷”。
cues.en: "completely indifferent to travelers needs".

cues.zh: 如果有问题，请填写投诉表，
cues.en: If there is a problem, fill out complaint form,

cues.zh: 然后把它装进信封，收件人写你出生时
cues.en: and place it in an envelope addressed to the name of the hospital

cues.zh: 所在医院的名字。
cues.en: in which you were born.

cues.zh: 针对这一排名，机场增设了公共广播系统
cues.en: In response to the ranking, the airport added a public address system

cues.zh: 试图消除任何困惑。
cues.en: in an attempt to clear up any confusion.

cues.zh: 早到的出发航班和晚点的到达航班
cues.en: Departures arriving early and arrivals landing late

cues.zh: 可能在没有事先通知的情况下被取消或延误。
cues.en: may be canceled or delayed without the prior notice.

cues.zh: 机场还设立了一条免费客户服务热线。
cues.en: The airport also created a toll-free customer service helpline.

cues.zh: 但本周我们的记者拨打这个号码时，
cues.en: But when our reporters called the number this week,

cues.zh: 发现它接通的是斯图加特的一家帽子店。
cues.en: they found it connected them to a hat store in Stuttgart.

cues.zh: 旅客们也抱怨机场的安检程序太不寻常
cues.en: Travelers also report being frustrated by the airport's unusual security procedure

cues.zh: 其中包括耗时冗长的个人面谈。
cues.en: which includes a time consuming personal interview.

cues.zh: 一名保安问了我大概80分钟，
cues.en: A security guard asked me, for like 80 minutes,

cues.zh: 你是你所说的那个人吗？你是你所说的那个人吗？
cues.en: are you who you say you are? Are you who you say you are?

cues.zh: 最后，他在我手背上写下“liar”（骗子），然后放我过去了。
cues.en: And finally, he writes lyar on the back of my hand and lets me pass.

cues.zh: 机场官员表示，这些投诉毫无根据。
cues.en: Airport officials say the complaints are unfounded.

cues.zh: 你必须明白，所有问题都是旅客自己的问题。
cues.en: You must understand, all problems are traveller's own.

cues.zh: 只要你确保正确遵守了正规流程，
cues.en: If you only made certain to properly follow proper protocols,

cues.zh: 就不会存在这样的问题。
cues.en: no such problems would exist.

cues.zh: 正确遵守正规流程。
cues.en: Properly follow proper protocols.

cues.zh: 附近的陀思妥耶夫斯基酒店也被旅客打了低分。
cues.en: The nearby Dostoevsky Hotel also received low marks from the passengers.

cues.zh: 大批旅客因航班延误而入住
cues.en: A large number of whom checked in due to a flight delay

cues.zh: 最后却在酒店里谋杀了另一位客人。
cues.en: and ended up murdering another guest at the hotel.

cues.zh: 接下来，一份新的医疗报告警告说，癌症筛查
cues.en: Coming up, a new medical report warns getting screened for cancer

cues.zh: 是发现自己患癌的主要原因。
cues.en: is a leading cause of finding out you have cancer.

cues.zh: 本小时稍后：人质危机进入第14个漫长小时
cues.en: Still Ahead This Hour: Hostage Crisis Enters 14th Tedious Hour
